messages.content: Write the video script JSON for: مطاردة ليلية على الكورنيش فالدار البيضاء.

{"title": "ليل الكورنيش", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Night aerial of the Casablanca corniche, wet asphalt reflecting purple neon, one car weaving through empty lanes, cinematic moody grade", "vo": "الكورنيش فالليل، والمدينة كاملة قدامنا.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Interior car shot, hands gripping the wheel, dashboard glow on a focused face, city lights streaking past the window", "vo": "القاعدة بسيطة: ماتشوفش الضوء الأحمر.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Low angle tracking shot of tires slicing through rain puddles, spray exploding in slow motion under streetlights", "vo": "المطر صار موسيقى، والمحرك الإيقاع.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Wide shot: the car drifts around a seaside roundabout, lighthouse beam sweeping across the frame, neon reflections dancing", "vo": "اللفة الأخيرة قبل البحر.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 5, "visual": "Car stops at the pier edge, brake lights bleeding red into wet ground, driver steps out silhouette against the Atlantic", "vo": "وصطى الليل، البحر هو المحكمة.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: صعود فنان من الحومة للمسرح.

{"title": "من الحومة للضو", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Golden hour over a cramped medina rooftop, young rapper scribbling rhymes in a worn notebook, laundry lines and satellite dishes around", "vo": "كل كلام كتبتو هنا، فالسطح.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Close-up of cracked sneakers climbing steep stairs, warm sunset light cutting through narrow alley shadows", "vo": "الدرج طويل، ولكن الحلم أطول.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Backstage mirror lit by a single bulb, artist breathing slowly, mic tape wrapped around fingers, crowd rumble beyond the curtain", "vo": "خلف الكواليس، القلب كيدق بزاف.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Slow push-in from behind: silhouette steps into blinding stage lights, sea of raised hands in haze", "vo": "ومن هادي... كتبدا الحكاية الحقيقية.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: محقق يتبع أدلة في مدينة مطرة.

{"title": "أثر المطر", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Rain-drenched neon alley, detective in long coat crouches over a glowing clue, reflections trembling in black puddles, noir palette", "vo": "المطر يمسح كل شي... إلا الأثر.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Extreme close-up: a burned match and a torn photo held with tweezers, evidence bag light, rain drumming on tin roof", "vo": "علامة تجارية، وصبغة من الورق.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Detective's face lit by a flickering bar sign, smoking figure watching from a window above, vertical neon streaks", "vo": "المشكوك فيه فوق، وأنا تحت.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Rooftop confrontation in heavy rain, two silhouettes facing, city grid glittering below like a circuit board", "vo": "المدينة كلها شهود، وماحد يشهد.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: رحلة صباحية في جبال الأطلس.

{"title": "فجر الأطلس", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Drone rises over terraced Atlas mountain village at dawn, mist pooling in valleys, first light touching snow peaks", "vo": "قبل ما تصحى المدينة، الجبال صحت.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Shepherd silhouette walking a ridge line, breath visible in cold air, sun cresting the peak behind him", "vo": "خطوة بخطوة، والسماء كلها لي.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Close-up of mint tea poured into a glass, steam curling in golden light, weathered hands steady", "vo": "أتاي فالفجر طعمو مختلف.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Wide drone shot: trail switchbacking down to a green oasis, birds crossing frame, day fully arriving", "vo": "الطريق طويل، ولكن السماء صافية.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: ليلة مباراة والشوارع مشتعلة.

{"title": "ليلة الماتش", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Handheld rush through a packed fan zone, flares smoking red, flags snapping, faces painted, chaotic energy", "vo": "البلاد كاملة في زنقة وحدة الليلة.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Slow motion: goal on a big screen, hundred heads snap back screaming, drinks flying, strobe of phone lights", "vo": "گول! والدنيا هزات.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Street cascade: crowd floods onto the boulevard, honking cars, someone waves a giant flag from a moving bus", "vo": "الشارع ولا الملاعب.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Dawn aftermath: empty square littered with scarves, street sweeper smiles, sunrise over the stadium arch", "vo": "وصباحها... البطولة باقية فالقلب.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: a heist crew walks into a midnight casino.

{"title": "Midnight Mirage", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Rain-slick casino entrance at midnight, neon signage bleeding into puddles, four silhouettes in tailored coats step through golden doors", "vo": "At midnight, the house always wins — usually.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Interior: chandelier glare, slow-motion roulette spin, dealer's eyes tracking the crew as they split across the floor", "vo": "Four players, one table, zero mistakes allowed.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Extreme close-up: a card palmed, a camera lens rotating away on its own, a bartender sliding a key across mahogany", "vo": "Every eye is a lock. We brought the keys.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Vault door swings open, stacks glowing under red light, crew exchanges a single nod as alarms silently arm", "vo": "Ten seconds of red light. Then silence.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: the last summer before everything changed.

{"title": "The Last July", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "35mm grain: kids leaping off a lake dock at sunset, lens flare, film scratches, endless golden water", "vo": "That summer, the water was always warm.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Polaroid photo taped to a bedroom mirror, four laughing faces, sunlight crawling across the wallpaper", "vo": "We took one photo. We thought there'd be thousands.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Two friends on a car hood at dusk, radio glowing, sharing earbuds, fireflies starting over the fields", "vo": "One song on repeat. No reason to move.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Empty dock at dawn, a single bike lying on its side, lake perfectly still", "vo": "September came. The dock remembers.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: a lone climber conquers a frozen peak.

{"title": "The Summit", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Aerial: a lone climber traverses a knife-edge ridge, clouds racing below, sun flaring off ice axes", "vo": "Six thousand meters. One line upward.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Macro: ice crystals forming on an oxygen mask, breath fogging, gloved fingers trembling on carabiners", "vo": "The mountain doesn't care. That's why we climb.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Wide: storm wall approaching, climber anchors in and holds as white fury engulf the frame", "vo": "Hold. Breathe. Hold.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Sunrise summit: climber stands above an ocean of clouds, flag planted, orchestra swelling, horizon burning gold", "vo": "Above the clouds, the world finally fits.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: a courier races through a neon megacity.

{"title": "Neon Run", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Cyberpunk megacity canyon, hover-drones scanning, courier on a glowing bike weaving through holographic traffic at insane speed", "vo": "Package. Thirty minutes. The whole city between us.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Glitch transition: courier's HUD zooms — route flickering through eight alleys, drone net tightening, countdown burning red", "vo": "Drones ahead. Walls behind. One road left.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Wheel cam: bike leaping a canal gap in slow motion, sparks raining, holo-ads shattering like glass", "vo": "Sometimes the shortcut is a leap of faith.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Rooftop skid to a stop, hand-off of a glowing case to a hooded figure, city grid glittering below", "vo": "Delivered. Never ask what was inside.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: un matin au marché de Marseille.

{"title": "Le Marché", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Documentary style: dawn light on the Vieux-Port, fishermen unloading crates, gulls swirling, harbor bells", "vo": "Marseille se réveille avec la mer.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Market stall close-ups: hands stacking oranges, weathered smile, price chalk squeaking on a slate", "vo": "Ici, chaque fruit a une histoire.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Tracking shot: an old regular greets three vendors in a row, bread under one arm, gossip in the air", "vo": "Le marché, c'est le parlement du quartier.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Wide golden shot: crowded stalls under awnings, sun climbing, laughter over the fish scale clatter", "vo": "À midi, tout le monde repart avec plus que des courses.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: un verano infinito en la costa.

{"title": "Verano Infinito", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Pastel slow motion: kids running through a sprinkler at dusk, water droplets like glass beads, lavender sky", "vo": "El verano no terminaba nunca.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Super 8 look: a girl's hair lifting in the sea breeze on a boardwalk, candy colors, gentle lens flare", "vo": "Y el mar guardaba todos los secretos.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Underwater shot: sunlight rays through turquoise, laughing faces looking down from the surface", "vo": "Debajo del agua, el tiempo iba más lento.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Empty beach at golden hour, one towel, one pair of sandals, waves erasing footprints", "vo": "Nos fuimos. El verano se quedó.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: 放課後の屋上での決闘.

{"title": "屋上の約束", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Anime style: after-school rooftop at sunset, two students facing off, wind lifting uniforms, city skyline blazing orange", "vo": "放課後、屋上。約束通りだ。", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Dynamic speed lines: a wooden sword drawn in a flash, cherry petals spiraling, eyes narrowing in close-up", "vo": "一度だけ、本気で行く。", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Slow motion clash: blades crossing, shockwave rippling the clouds above, pupils locking", "vo": "全力じゃなきゃ、失礼だからな。", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Both laughing on the fence at dusk, graduation clouds rolling past, sunset bleeding into purple", "vo": "……勝負は、まだ続くな。", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: ночная поездка по заснеженному городу.

{"title": "Снежный маршрут", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Minimalist night: a tram glides through falling snow, warm windows glowing, frozen city hushed and white", "vo": "Ночь. Город спит под снегом.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Inside the tram: breath fogging the glass, a passenger draws a small bird in the frost with one finger", "vo": "На стекле — птица, которая не улетит.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Snow crunch underfoot crossing an empty square, lamplight halos, cathedral silhouette behind flakes", "vo": "Тишина, в которой слышно себя.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Tram recedes into the white distance, tracks vanishing under fresh snow, one lit window remains", "vo": "Утром снег всё скроет. Но не забудет.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: launch night of the Fenix flagship phone.

{"title": "Fenix One — Launch Night", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Sleek product-ad: black glass tower wrapped in purple light beams, gold confetti freezing mid-air, Fenix One logo reveal", "vo": "Tonight, Fenix changes everything.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Macro beauty shot: titanium edge rotating, camera lenses blooming open like an iris, reflections sliding across glass", "vo": "Precision you can feel before you touch it.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Crowd: phone screens lighting up in waves across a dark auditorium, faces glowing, countdown hitting zero", "vo": "Ten thousand hands. One device.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Hero shot: the phone standing upright on a pedestal, purple and gold light wrapping around it, city lights beyond the glass", "vo": "Fenix One. The night belongs to you.", "secs": 6}]}
Write the video script JSON for: 3am coding session that becomes a breakthrough.

{"title": "3AM", "scenes": [{"n": 1, "visual": "Lo-fi cozy: dark room lit by monitor glow, coffee steam rising, cat asleep on a hoodie, code scrolling softly", "vo": "3AM. The bug knows it's cornered.", "secs": 6}, {"n": 2, "visual": "Close-up: tired eyes reflecting green terminal text, fingers hovering, rain starting against the window", "vo": "One more try. That's what the last fifty said.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 3, "visual": "Screen floods green — tests passing one by one, fists slowly rising, chair spinning back in disbelief", "vo": "It builds. IT BUILDS.", "secs": 5}, {"n": 4, "visual": "Sunrise creeps over the windowsill onto the keyboard, head finally resting on folded arms, cat relocates to shoulder", "vo": "Shipped by sunrise. Legend by lunch.", "secs": 6}]}
